snippet.title: Shape of Dreams - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Shape of Dreams, a top-down action dungeon crawler developed by Lizard Smoothie. Playera will fight through ever-changing realms alone or with friends to make use of flashy attacks and strategies. Shape of Dreams is available now for PC (Steam).
